title: HQ-194, Eagle Has Landed: The Flight of Apollo 11 (1969 NASA film)
contents: Real 16mm film from the Lunar Module window during the final descent of Eagle onto the Sea of Tranquility, ending at the moment of touchdown (dust kicked up). Original film soundtrack (narration/crew audio) kept. 4:3, 648x486 (NTSC source deinterlaced, aspect corrected).
licence: Public domain: NASA-produced media, generally not subject to US copyright (NASA Media Usage Guidelines). Do not imply NASA endorsement; do not use NASA logos/insignia as channel branding. Archival copy also held by NARA (ID 45017).
